```{r, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)

```

```{r}
patient_id <- function(pid) {
  m <- str_match(pid, "^CAR-(\\d+)$")
  n <- as.integer(m[,2])
  ifelse(!is.na(n),
         paste("CAR", n, sep = "-"),
         NA_character_)
}
```

# Data

## Clinical variables

```{r}
cl_var <- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "data/metadata_updated.xlsx")
cl_var <- cl_var[!is.na(cl_var$Outcome12m_PD1), ]
cl_var$Outcome3m_PDSD1 <- NULL
cl_var$LineePre <- NULL
cl_var$ToxCRS_maxGrade <- NULL
cl_var$ToxICANS_maxGrade <- NULL

cl_var$ID <- patient_id(cl_var$ID)

cl_var$Prodotto <- revalue(cl_var$Prodotto, c("Axicel" = "1", "Tisacel" = "0"))
cl_var$Sex <- revalue(cl_var$Sex, c("M" = "1", "F" = "0"))

cl_var$Istologia <- revalue(cl_var$Sex, c("DLBCL" = "1", "HGBCL" = "1", "PMBCL" = "0"))
cl_var <- cl_var[order(cl_var$ID), ]

cl_var <- cl_var[, -c(20, 22)]
```

## miRNA

```{r}
mirna_mat <- read_xlsx("data/filtered_mirna.xlsx")
mirna_mat <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(mirna_mat)))
colnames(mirna_mat) <- mirna_mat[1, ]
mirna_mat <- mirna_mat[-1, ]
mirna_mat <- mirna_mat[order(rownames(mirna_mat)), ]
mirna_mat <- mirna_mat[rownames(mirna_mat) %in% cl_var$ID, ]
```

# Selection

```{r}
data <- cbind(cl_var, mirna_mat)
data$selection <- paste(data$Prodotto, data$Outcome12m_PD1, sep = "_")
```

## Discovery/Test selection

```{r split1}
split <- function(data) {
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = data$selection, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  ll <- list(discovery = data[inTrain, ], test = data[-inTrain, ])
  return(ll)
}

set.seed(333)
split1 <- split(data)
```

## Train/Validation selection

```{r train}
train_valid <- function(discovery){ 
  inTrain <- createDataPartition(y = discovery$selection, p = .75, list = FALSE)
  train <- discovery[inTrain, ]
  train$ID <- train$selection <- NULL

  valid <- discovery[-inTrain,]
  valid$ID <- valid$selection <- NULL
  
  ll <- list(train = train, valid = valid)
  return(ll)
}

set.seed(333)
split2 <- replicate(1000, train_valid(split1$discovery), simplify = FALSE)
train <- lapply(1:1000, function(i) split2[[i]][[1]])
valid <- lapply(1:1000, function(i) split2[[i]][[2]])
```

## Lasso

```{r pred}
slc_var <- function(model, lambda){
  coef <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(model, s = lambda)))
  coef$var <- rownames(coef)
  coef <- coef[abs(coef$s1) > 0, ]
  coef <- coef[-1, ]
  coef <- coef$var
  return(coef)
}

accuracy <- function(y_real, y_pred){
  tab <- table(factor(y_real, levels= 0:1), factor(y_pred, levels= 0:1))
  res <- (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2]) / (tab[1, 1] + tab[2, 2] + tab[1, 2] + tab[2, 1]) 
  return(res)
}

prediction <- function(lambda){
  fit <- lapply(train, function(x) glmnet(as.matrix(x[, -18]), x[, 18], family = "binomial", alpha = 1,
                                          lambda = lambda))
  var <- lapply(fit, function(x) slc_var(x, lambda))
  pred <- lapply(1:length(valid), function(i) as.data.frame(predict(fit[[i]], newx = as.matrix(valid[[i]][, -18]),
                                                                         type = "response", s = lambda)))
  pred <- lapply(pred, function(x) ifelse(x$s1 >= 0.5, 1, 0))
  
  y_real <- lapply(valid, function(x) x$Outcome12m_PD1)
  y_pred <- lapply(pred, function(x) x)
  
  res <- sapply(1:length(y_pred), function(i) accuracy(y_real = y_real[[i]], y_pred = y_pred[[i]]))
  mean <- mean(res)
  return(list(var = var, mean = mean))
}

set.seed(333)
lambda <- seq(0.001, 1, length = 100)
results <- mclapply(lambda, prediction, mc.cores = 8)
```

```{r}
mean <- sapply(results, function(x) x$mean)
names(mean) <- lambda
plot(mean)
```

```{r}
save(results, split1, file = "2025_04_15_cart_12mfup.RData")
```

```{r}
variables <- lapply(results, function(x) x$var)
names(variables) <- lambda

opt_lambda <- lambda[match(max(mean), mean)]
var_opt <- variables[[match(max(mean), mean)]]

len <- sapply(var_opt, function(x) length(x))
freq_opt <- do.call(rbind, lapply(var_opt, function(x) data.frame(var = x)))
freq_opt <- as.data.frame(table(freq_opt$var))
freq_opt$Freq <- 100*freq_opt$Freq/length(len)

freq_opt$type <- as.character(freq_opt$Var1)
freq_opt$type[grep("hsa", freq_opt$type)] <- "mirna"
freq_opt$type[freq_opt$type != "mirna"] <- "clinic"

freq_opt <- freq_opt[order(freq_opt$Freq, decreasing = T), ]

ggplot(freq_opt, aes(x=reorder(Var1, Freq, decreasing = TRUE), y=Freq, fill=type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0)) + ylim(0,100) + labs(x=NULL) + theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90), text=element_text(size=10))
```

# Final model

```{r}
discovery <- split1$discovery
discovery <- mapply(discovery, FUN=as.numeric)
test <- split1$test
test$ID <- test$selection <- NULL
y_real <- test$Outcome12m_PD1
test <- mapply(test, FUN=as.numeric)

freq_opt$Var1 <- as.character(freq_opt$Var1)
```

```{r}
select_model <- function(n_var){
  if(n_var == 0){
    fit <- glm(Outcome12m_PD1 ~., data = data.frame(Outcome12m_PD1 = discovery[, c("Outcome12m_PD1")]),
               family = "binomial")
  }
  else {
    fit <- glm(Outcome12m_PD1 ~., data = as.data.frame(discovery[, c("Outcome12m_PD1", freq_opt$Var1[1:n_var])]),
               family = "binomial")
  }
  
  pred <- round(predict(fit, newdata = as.data.frame(test[, -c(18)]), type = "response"))
  out <- accuracy(y_real = y_real, y_pred = pred)
  return(list(fit = fit, accuracy = out))
}
```

```{r}
fit <- lapply(0:5, function(i) select_model(i))
```


```{r}
n_var <- length(fit)-1
anova <- list()
pair <- numeric(0)
ind <- 0
for (i in 1:n_var) {
  ind <- ind +1
  pair[ind] <- paste(i-1, i, sep = "_")
  anova[[ind]] <- anova(fit[[i]]$fit, fit[[i+1]]$fit)
}
names(anova) <- pair
```

```{r}
fit0 <- glm(Outcome12m_PD1 ~., data = data.frame(Outcome12m_PD1 = discovery[, c("Outcome12m_PD1")]),
            family = "binomial")
summary(fit0)
pred0 <- round(predict(fit0, newdata = as.data.frame(test[,-c(21)]), type = "response"))
accuracy(y_real = y_real, y_pred = pred0)

anova(fit0, fit1)
```
